Unofficial fan-made launcher for inFAMOUS, inFAMOUS 2 and inFAMOUS: Festival of Blood on PC.

inFAMOUS is a trademark of Sony Interactive Entertainment; the games are by Sucker Punch Productions. You need your own copies.

Emulator: RPCS3 (GPL-2.0). Patches: RPCS3's patch database.

Full credits in CREDITS.md.
